titleEn: Least Number of Unique Integers after K Removals
title: 不同整数的最少数目
summary: 从数组恰好删除 k 个元素，求剩余不同整数数量的最小值。
insight: 为了最少种类，应优先完整删除出现次数最少的值；按频次升序消耗 k，无法完整删除下一类时停止。
pitfalls: 只删除某类一部分不会减少种类数
删除次数恰为 k，但剩余删除可落在现存类内
返回未被完整删除的类别数

solutions.title: 频次升序贪心删除
solutions.idea: 以最小代价逐个消除整数类别。
steps: 统计每个值频次并升序排序 frequencies
若 k>=frequency，则 k-=frequency、unique--；否则停止，返回 unique

code.java: class Solution { public int findLeastNumOfUniqueInts(int[] arr,int k){Map<Integer,Integer> count=new HashMap<>();for(int value:arr)count.merge(value,1,Integer::sum);List<Integer> frequencies=new ArrayList<>(count.values());Collections.sort(frequencies);int unique=frequencies.size();for(int frequency:frequencies){if(k<frequency)break;k-=frequency;unique--;}return unique;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findLeastNumOfUniqueInts(arr:IntArray,k:Int):Int{val frequencies=arr.toList().groupingBy{it}.eachCount().values.sorted();var remaining=k;var unique=frequencies.size;for(frequency in frequencies){if(remaining<frequency)break;remaining-=frequency;unique--};return unique} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int findLeastNumOfUniqueInts(vector<int>& arr,int k){unordered_map<int,int> count;for(int value:arr)++count[value];vector<int> frequencies;for(auto [value,frequency]:count)frequencies.push_back(frequency);sort(frequencies.begin(),frequencies.end());int unique=frequencies.size();for(int frequency:frequencies){if(k<frequency)break;k-=frequency;--unique;}return unique;} };
